title: MoS2 Out-of-Fold Explainability, Nuanced Decoupling, and Empirical Path Analysis

out_of_fold_variance_decomposition.methodology: Out-of-Fold GroupKFold-5 Decomposition with 1,000 Bootstrap Iterations
out_of_fold_variance_decomposition.scientific_qualification: Nuanced Decoupling: Intrinsic electronic structure and carrier accumulation explain the majority of out-of-fold contact resistance variation across independent publications (~68%), while extrinsic fabrication processing modifications (vdW transfer, chemistry, annealing) account for a meaningful ~14%, and device-to-device fabrication variability/noise constitutes ~18%.

observational_path_analysis.scientific_qualification: Observational Path Analysis: Because literature data are observational rather than randomized controlled trials, path coefficients reflect empirical associations and mediation hypotheses rather than conclusive causal proofs. Barrier height reduction statistically mediates a substantial fraction of the observed contact resistance improvement in de-pinned contacts.
